practices.applicability: A strong fit for a single-host pool and cache-read-dominated multi-turn traffic. Enable routing.session-affinity, which defaults to false, and size its TTL for expected idle gaps. The selector handles Claude/Codex identities and optional parent/subagent affinity. Keep prompt_cache_key stable and leave optional identity remapping disabled unless separately justified.

quality_risk.description: Steady-state affinity does not require content rewriting. However, automatic rebinding can invalidate cache locality or move account-owned state. Prefix similarity is not proof that continuation state is transferable. Parent affinity can also concentrate concurrent subagents on one account.

practices.verification_metric: Measure account switches per established session, normalized cached-read/total-input ratio, uncached tokens per completed task and p95 TTFT at fixed model/effort. Require no unexplained account switches and no regression from the approximately 90% cache-read baseline. Test idle expiry, account failure and subagent forks for context integrity.
evidence: The selector reuses an available binding across priority tiers and invokes fallback when necessary; explicit identity precedes Merkle-prefix matching: [selector](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/4a2c81864f31f39308e946c4c65e72147855da6e/sdk/cliproxy/auth/selector.go#L904-L1120).

The Responses path carries prompt_cache_key into the upstream request and Session-Id header: [cache identity](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/4a2c81864f31f39308e946c4c65e72147855da6e/internal/runtime/executor/codex_executor_request.go#L117-L154).

Claude documents prefix caching and invalidation from tool, thinking and effort changes. Reset and quota-headroom weights are opt-in and default to zero. For this workload, avoid letting small latency improvements repeatedly displace warm sessions; subscription quota consumption must be measured rather than inferred from API prices.

quality_risk.description: Account ranking need not change model, effort or content. Risk arises if model mappings are not equivalent, quota observations are stale, or latency-based sticky escape moves a stateful session. The no-loss deployment policy should restrict selection to verified equivalent routes and disable ungated sticky escape.

practices.verification_metric: At fixed model/effort, compare completed agent tasks per quota window, 429 rate, queue latency and remaining quota at reset. practices.applicability: Directly relevant to Codex HTTP/SSE Responses streams. The inspected implementation buffers startup frames under time, byte and frame limits and distinguishes bootstrap overload from other terminal failures. This does not establish equivalent WebSocket or Claude behavior.

quality_risk.description: A retry must retain model, effort and complete context and satisfy state-ownership requirements. Lack of downstream output alone does not prove that upstream side effects never occurred. Unbounded buffering increases latency; replay after tool output risks duplicate actions.

practices.verification_metric: Inject overload before output and interruption after the first content/tool delta. Require eligible pre-output recovery, zero model/effort changes, zero duplicated tool actions and no mixed-generation stream. Confirm post-output failure reaches the client explicitly and bootstrap latency stays within configured bounds.
evidence: Bootstrap overload is converted into a failed attempt before downstream commitment, while other terminal failures retain in-stream delivery: [bootstrap classification](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/4a2c81864f31f39308e946c4c65e72147855da6e/internal/runtime/executor/codex_executor_stream.go#L173-L229).

Buffering is bounded and later terminal failures are emitted through the stream: [bounds](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/4a2c81864f31f39308e946c4c65e72147855da6e/internal/runtime/executor/codex_executor_stream.go#L264-L291), [post-bootstrap failure](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/4a2c81864f31f39308e946c4c65e72147855da6e/internal/runtime/executor/codex_executor_stream.go#L356-L372).

This is a workload-specific inference, not a claim that cross-account cache reuse is universally impossible. Independent stateless requests can still use balancing after measurement.

notes: Conclusion: the evidence supports native-protocol, model/effort-preserving credential routing, stable session/cache affinity, capacity-aware assignment of new work, bounded admission and conservative state-aware failover. It does not establish a benchmark-proven universal SOTA winner or certify either complete gateway as lossless. As of 2026-09-28 UTC, the maintenance cutoff is 2026-06-30. Required default-branch REST queries were inaccessible; recent releases were not substituted for that evidence, and no repository was excluded as stale. Unknown candidates remain pending. No candidate code was installed or executed and no credentials were read.
